champions-reg-ma.label: Champions Reg M-A
champions-reg-ma.notes: Ban-only format: all Legendary, Mythical, and Paradox Pokémon are banned (0 Restricted slots). Mega Evolution reintroduced (59 species). Legality mirrors bundled Regulation H ban list—confirm before events.

champions-reg-mb.label: Champions Reg M-B
champions-reg-mb.notes: Ban-only format, same base as Reg M-A: all Legendary, Mythical, and Paradox Pokémon are banned (0 Restricted slots). Adds 22 newly usable Pokémon and 16 new Mega Evolutions (75 total) over Reg M-A. Legality mirrors bundled Regulation H ban list—confirm before events, official 2026 World Championships format.

regulation-i.label: Regulation I
regulation-i.notes: Up to 2 Restricted Pokémon per team. Lists follow official Scarlet/Violet Regulation I (May–Aug 2025).

regulation-j.label: Regulation J
regulation-j.notes: Placeholder ruleset — legality mirrors Regulation I until official Regulation J lists are published.

regulation-h.label: Regulation H
regulation-h.notes: Ban-only format: Paradox Pokémon, Treasures of Ruin, Legendary and Mythical Pokémon are not allowed. Most other Paldea, Kitakami, and Blueberry dex Pokémon are legal.
